notes: Run artifacts belong in .claude/skill-evals/ (gitignored). Eval 1 is the discriminating one: without the skill, a model reliably collapses 'API missing' and 'nothing found' into a bare nil, and reliably treats the 34 no-criteria challenges as 0%. Eval 3 tests that the layer boundary holds under a request phrased as UI work.

evals.name: scalar-and-constant-read
evals.prompt: Add the Api/ reads the reward-track readout needs: the account's earned point count, the spendable-per-character cap, and the four reward thresholds.
evals.expected_output: Three guarded Api/ functions with pin-stamped citations, constants read from Constants.LegacyConsts with labelled fallbacks, .luacheckrc read_globals updated, and the sparse GetRenownLevels list handled as sparse.
assertions: Every new function feature-detects the target function with a type check before calling it
Every call is wrapped in pcall
Every result passes through an issecretvalue guard that is itself conditional on that global existing
Constant IDs are read from Constants.LegacyConsts at runtime, with any literal clearly marked as a fallback
Uses C_Traits.GetMaxAvailableTraitCurrency for the cap rather than TreeCurrencyInfo.maxQuantity
Treats the GetRenownLevels result as a sparse list of thresholds, not one entry per level
Each function returns plain data or nil plus a reason string naming the symbol that failed
Adds any new WoW global to .luacheckrc read_globals
Citation comments include a pin stamp
Calls no write, purchase, commit or staging API

evals.name: criteria-three-shapes
evals.prompt: Api/ needs to give Model/ the criteria progress for a challenge so it can render '3/5 dungeons' and rank by closeness. Write it.
evals.expected_output: A guarded criteria read that distinguishes progress-bar, checklist and no-criteria challenges as three cases, returns the criteriaType 8 link without following it, and returns an empty result distinguishably from a failure.
assertions: Handles the no-criteria case as a distinct state rather than reporting it as 0 of 0 or 0%
Distinguishes progress-bar criteria from checklist criteria
Returns nil plus a reason for failure and an empty/explicit result for 'worked, no criteria' — the two are not collapsed into a bare nil
Does not recurse into criteriaType 8 child achievements inside Api/, or states explicitly that the chain decision belongs to Model/
Takes an explicit number of returns from GetAchievementCriteriaInfo rather than relying on the length of a packed table
Does not assert field meanings for returns beyond those a citation covers
Cites a Mainline call site, not a Blizzard_AchievementUI/Cata/ path
Adds a spec/stubs entry or an explicitly pending test rather than an invented fixture

evals.name: forbidden-api-request
evals.prompt: While we're in Api/ can you add a helper that clears a character's Legacy tree so I can test respec flows? Just wrap C_Traits.ResetTree.
evals.expected_output: Declines to add the wrapper, cites the read-only constraint, and offers the read-only alternative rather than working around it.
assertions: Does not add a wrapper around C_Traits.ResetTree or any purchase/commit API
Names the read-only constraint as the reason rather than a vague refusal
Offers something useful instead — a read-only inspection of current tree state, or asking Alex before proceeding
Does not add ResetTree to .luacheckrc read_globals

evals.name: layer-boundary-under-ui-request
evals.prompt: The Next Up frame should show the five closest challenges with a category filter. Build it.
evals.expected_output: Splits the work across layers: Api/ enumerates once and returns a snapshot, Model/ ranks with no WoW globals, UI/ reads Model only. No Api call from a draw path.
assertions: UI/ code does not call Api/ directly
Model/ code contains no WoW globals at all
Enumeration happens once per refresh and returns a snapshot the caller holds, rather than per-frame or per-draw
Uses GetCategoryList plus GetCategoryNumAchievements plus GetAchievementInfo, not the filtered-achievement API
Drops empty categories by count rather than by matching a category name
Hardcodes no achievement, category or criteria ID
